functions.description: Sub screen background load and scroll state machine
functions.notes: Size and shape match (0x310). Two register differences remain: at +0x174 the else-branch label-pair temp (obj+0x44) lands in ip, target has r7; in the tilemap fill loop the shifted palette attribute lands in r5 and the address temp in r3, target has them swapped (attr r3, address r5). colorsweep --apply made no change. Tried: hoisted offset declaration, named locals for the label pair, element-wise label stores, attr inside or outside the loop, unsigned/int/uchar palette, pointer vs 2D array indexing for the tilemap store. Second field offsets: scrollY 0xc6, targetY 0xc8, bgIndex 0xd4.
